summary: The fixture realizes a valid DOCUMENTING state on the export base. It adds an offline link checker that passes and a remote preview helper whose host is blocked, so the preview fails realistically, and nothing in the repository says the preview is optional. Checks and invariants are necessary conditions that a correct run satisfies, including the turn-end coverage of AC-001 and AC-002 in a COMPLETE documentation record.
